source_checks.dataset: West Bengal WUA point crop-survey GIS layer
source_checks.check: The app's existing privacy-limited coverage endpoint fetched agronomic fields only and excluded geometry, coordinates, remarks, global IDs and editor metadata. A separate count-only query returned 19.
source_checks.result: Too sparse and not district-matched for supervised training. Point rows were not archived. The layer schema includes precise coordinates and editor metadata, and no reuse license is recorded.

training_gaps.crop_weather_stress: Requires many verified, dated crop-health, crop-damage or yield-loss labels matched to crop, season, district/block/field and weather. Current WUA layer has only one labeled point; annual mango yield is not a crop-stress label.
training_gaps.mgnrega_shortfall: Requires a complete versioned monthly district series with households demanding work and households receiving work, reporting period, revisions and stable district keys. No usable series was downloaded.
training_gaps.broader_livelihood_disruption: Requires a defined outcome/horizon and authorized representative dated household or suitably granular aggregate outcomes. No such dataset is present.
